sentences.en: When the lecturer turned round, he sneaked out of the classroom.
sentences.zh: 当讲师转身时，他偷偷溜出了教室。

sentences.en: May I sneak in? My flight is leaving soon.
sentences.zh: 我可以悄悄进来吗？我的航班马上就要起飞了。

sentences.en: He sneaked up on him in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 他在半夜里悄悄接近了他。

senses.zh: 鬼鬼祟祟的人；偷偷摸摸的行为；告密者
溜；鬼鬼祟祟做事；向老师打小报告
